guidance.bestFor: A Getting started panel of 2 described links next to a plain Documentation link styled as a trigger
agentNotes: Documentation gets its trigger look from `navigationMenuTriggerStyle`; pass it as the `className` of any top level `NavigationMenuLink`

whenNotToUse.when: One line links each led by a status glyph and no summary text

guidance.bestFor: A Components trigger whose 4 titled summaries sit in 1 column and split into 2 columns from md up
agentNotes: `components` is sample data whose Scroll-area entry carries a separator summary; replace it with your pages, each `href` feeding its link

whenNotToUse.when: Panel cards that each need a leading glyph and a full width call to action below

guidance.bestFor: A narrow Status panel of 2 one line links, Backlog and Done, each led by a status glyph

whenNotToUse.when: Links that carry a short summary line under each label

title: Navigation menu with grid layout and learn more button.
label: Learn More Button
description: Navigation menu with grid layout and learn more button.

guidance.bestFor: An Industries panel of 8 segments in a fixed 2 column grid, each with a glyph and summary, above a full width Learn more button
agentNotes: Each `NavigationMenuLink` renders a fixed hash link, so the `href` on every `industries` entry is never read

whenNotToUse.when: Cards that should stack in 1 column below the md breakpoint
